entries.problem: llama.cpp submodule tag checkout fails in a shallow clone ('origin/b10428 is not a commit')
entries.cause: --depth 1 --branch <tag> fetches only the default branch, so release tags are absent
entries.solution: submodule add shallow, then fetch --depth 1 origin tag b10428 + checkout + git add the gitlink

entries.problem: SafeExpr compile error: 'inferred type is () -> Int but SafeExpr.Ref was expected'
entries.cause: parseExpr called with a trailing lambda { pos } instead of the Ref holder
entries.solution: val pos = Ref(0); parseExpr(tokens, pos); check pos.value != tokens.size

entries.problem: Redeclaration: ToolResult + 'Cannot find a parameter with this name: id/inputHash'
entries.cause: agent tool result duplicated the Phase 2 DB record name ToolResult (MemoryModels.kt)
entries.solution: rename tool-execution result to ToolOutput; the DB record keeps ToolResult

entries.problem: 'Returns are not allowed for functions with expression body' in parseSseEvent
entries.cause: unlabeled return null inside fun ... = try { }
entries.solution: make the if/else the try value; no bare return

entries.problem: 'Smart cast to ModelDescriptor is impossible — captured by a changing closure'
entries.cause: nullable var reassigned inside a catch while read inside flow lambdas
entries.solution: non-null via ?: run { emit(Error); return@flow }; var stays non-null

entries.problem: ld.lld: undefined symbol ggml_threadpool_new / ggml_threadpool_free
entries.cause: threadpool API lives in the CPU backend (ggml-cpu.c), dlopen'd under GGML_BACKEND_DL=ON — not linkable from native-lib
entries.solution: pin the calling decode thread before first graph compute; pthreads inherit creator affinity; no direct ggml-cpu link; -llog for logcat

entries.problem: setContent in MainActivity: 'receiver type mismatch'
entries.cause: androidx.activity.compose.setContent is a ComponentActivity extension; activity extended plain android.app.Activity
entries.solution: extend androidx.activity.ComponentActivity

entries.problem: memory retrieval ranked by hand-rolled linear recency, not the spec's BM25 × exponential decay
entries.cause: Phase 2 scoring predated the math spec (score = utility*0.5 + recency*0.3 + success*0.2)
entries.solution: ftsCandidates selects bm25(experiences_fts) AS bm25_rank; score = -rank * exp(-0.05*ageDays) + small tiebreaks; decay SQL lambda 0.02 -> 0.05

entries.problem: FGS specialUse requires both the permission and the subtype property at targetSdk 34
entries.cause: Android 14 introduced FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE with a required PROPERTY_SPECIAL_USE_FGS_SUBTYPE
entries.solution: declare FOREGROUND_SERVICE + FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE + POST_NOTIFICATIONS; service foregroundServiceType=specialUse + property; request POST_NOTIFICATIONS at runtime (API 33+)

entries.problem: setup-java v4 deprecation annotation; web_search ok flag coupled to a magic string
entries.cause: actions/setup-java@v4 is deprecated; WebSearchTool checked result.startsWith('web search unavailable')
entries.solution: migrate to actions/setup-java@v5; SearchProvider returns SearchResult(text, ok), LocalFallbackProvider ok=false; playbook phase 5 marked done

entries.problem: local llama.cpp init fails on-device: 'no backends are loaded'
entries.cause: AGP default extractNativeLibs=false packs .so in APK so nativeLibraryDir is empty; ggml_backend_load_all() searched exec dir + cwd only
entries.solution: android:extractNativeLibs=true + ggml_backend_load_all_from_path(nativeLibraryDir) before llama_backend_init; verified on-device init OK (RSS 729 MB, Qwen0.5B Q4_K_M, contended)

entries.problem: 'E: Unable to locate package shaderc' on the Ubuntu 24.04 runner
entries.cause: shaderc was restructured in noble; llama.cpp's own CI uses glslc + spirv-headers
entries.solution: apt-get install -y glslc libvulkan-dev spirv-headers

entries.problem: Agent button crash: SQLiteException no such module: fts5
entries.cause: OP7 OxygenOS Android 10 SQLite lacks the FTS5 extension; MemoryDatabase.onCreate DDL failed and startSession ran outside try/catch -> uncaught coroutine crash
entries.solution: detect FTS5 availability (try/catch DDL), fall back to bounded LIKE term-hit retrieval; wrap startSession/endSession so memory failure degrades gracefully

entries.problem: Agent unusable: persisted remote provider not re-registered after restart; local model required manual pre-load
entries.cause: providers registered only on picker selection; runAgent early-returned for unloaded local; messages not actionable
entries.solution: re-register persisted remote at startup; auto-load local GGUF on Agent/Generate; add in-app GGUF downloader (space check, magic verify, tmp+rename) + context selector; industrial UI redesign with real engine-state header

entries.problem: UI implied free remote models require an API key
entries.cause: health() hard-failed on blank key; Zen anonymous billing source is actually supported (per-IP rate-limited)
entries.solution: health() treats anonymous as healthy; omit Authorization when key blank; 429 -> actionable message; UI shows amber 'Free · anonymous (rate-limited)' and dialog clarifies keys only raise the quota

entries.problem: evaluate LiteRT/LiteRT-LM as a faster local inference backend for OP7
entries.cause: LiteRT-LM (Google AI Edge, ex-TFLite) advertises GPU/NPU LLM acceleration, tool use, on-device LoRA; local 1B Q4 is ~1.8 tok/s (contended)
entries.solution: audited upstream (v0.16.0); parked as reference only (ADR-007 + docs/source-research/litert-lm.md) because runtime is .tflite/.litertlm with no GGUF path — replacing llama.cpp needs a new export pipeline + second runtime and risks the 1.5 GB gate. Revisit on triggers: memory embedder via TFLite, same-device benchmark win, Phase 9 LoRA

entries.problem: remote quick-send/Agent showed ERROR 'generate failed: Flow exception transparency is violated' and produced zero tokens
entries.cause: OpenAICompatibleProvider emitted ModelStreamEvent.Error from a bare catch block AND emitted inside withContext(Dispatchers.IO) within the flow builder; kotlinx.coroutines 1.8 bans emit in a context different from the collection context (FlowExceptionTransparencyViolatedException), killing the whole stream
entries.solution: stream() = flow { HTTP/SSE work }.flowOn(Dispatchers.IO) + .catch { emit(Error) } - never emit inside withContext/catch inside a builder; regression tests (unreachable endpoint -> Error event; local ServerSocket SSE stub -> tokens then Done); reproduced locally with kotlinc + kotlinx-coroutines-core-jvm + org.json jars before burning CI cycles

entries.problem: pm install -r -d -t failed INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE on every CI APK; certs drifted run-to-run (0b045c7c/64ced54c/7f721a2c) vs persistent 21add73b
entries.cause: AGP silently regenerated a random debug keystore each run despite the restored ~/.android/debug.keystore (JDK17 default keystore type is PKCS12 so a JKS fails to load; explicit signingConfig also failed to load it) - only the installed app's original key allows in-place update
entries.solution: pragmatic, per user decision: accept the new signature - pm uninstall + pm install -t + restore model from /sdcard/Download/nativeai-model-backup.gguf via 'run-as com.engine.nativeai sh -c cat > files/models/model.gguf' (app uid CAN read /sdcard/Download); keep DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64 restore + keytool validation in the workflow but do not gate builds on it

entries.problem: cannot push files (APK) to the device from the proot shell: proot /storage/emulated/0/1DMP is an ext4 image not visible to the device shell; proot /tmp differs; adb unusable (127.0.0.1:5555 timeout); SELinux blocks pm from reading /sdcard
entries.cause: proot rootfs is a separate filesystem; device shell sees the real /storage/emulated/0/1DMP (1DM download folder); host-bridge shizuku has no root
entries.solution: python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 0.0.0.0 inside a persistent exec session + device 'curl -o /data/local/tmp/x.apk http://192.168.1.3:8000/x.apk' + 'pm install -t /data/local/tmp/x.apk'; model restore via run-as cat from /sdcard/Download (verified READ_OK)

entries.problem: Track A compile: 'Unresolved reference: EngineServiceState' + 'Comparison of incompatible enums'
entries.cause: enum declared INSIDE the companion object is not promoted to the outer class name (only members are); Class.EngineServiceState fails to resolve
entries.solution: declare EngineServiceState at top level of the service file; reference EngineServiceState.STOPPED directly

entries.problem: Track E compile: 'Unresolved reference: context' in ExecutionManager.backend()
entries.cause: a constructor parameter without val/var is only visible in property initializers/init, not in method bodies
entries.solution: class ExecutionManager(private val context: Context)

entries.problem: JVM tests: ExecutionLayerTestKt > initializationError InvalidTestClassError
entries.cause: appended JUnit test landed OUTSIDE the class (after the closing brace) -> top-level @Test in the file facade ExecutionLayerTestKt, which JUnit rejects
entries.solution: keep every @Test inside the class body; verify with tail -n before pushing (104 tests now green)

entries.problem: 'GGML_CPU_ALL_VARIANTS requires GGML_BACKEND_DL' at CMake configure
entries.cause: llama.cpp gates ALL_VARIANTS behind dynamic backend loading (ggml/src/CMakeLists.txt:373)
entries.solution: set GGML_BACKEND_DL=ON together with GGML_CPU_ALL_VARIANTS=ON (mirrors llama.cpp build-android.yml)

entries.problem: Termux execution absent at the core execution layer; user wants it core-level, optional Anyclaw/Codex/OpenCode later
entries.cause: audit had parked TermuxBackend; only LocalProcessBackend existed
entries.solution: TermuxBackend (clean-room): com.termux detection + RunCommandService intent (com.termux.RUN_COMMAND) + file exchange /sdcard/Download/nativeai/<runId>/; TermuxStatus machine with honest reasons; ExecutionManager (Termux READY ? termux : local); Tools settings row; terminalEnabled/terminalAllowlist prefs; READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE maxSdk 32 + MediaStore fallback for API 33+. One-time user setup: termux-setup-storage + Allow external apps

entries.problem: tools invisible/uncontrolled; no inventory contract between ToolRegistry and UI
entries.cause: ToolRegistry exposed only descriptions(); settings had just the terminal row
entries.solution: ToolDescriptor + ToolRegistry.snapshot() + shared Toolbox (one construction path for agent and settings); Tools section shows every tool with AVAILABLE/DISABLED/APPROVAL/PRIVILEGED badges

entries.problem: agent trace could not prove which execution backend ran a terminal command
entries.cause: TerminalTool output had no backend marker
entries.solution: AgentTool.backendLabel (termux/local) + TerminalTool prefixes observations with [termux]/[local]

entries.problem: no authoritative model status line; quota static until manual health press; no system prompt override; Stats lacked affinity + dynamic budget
entries.cause: no derived status, no auto health refresh, hardcoded system prompt, affinity pin result only logged
entries.solution: ModelStatus.line() (READY/AVAILABLE/NO MODEL FILE/ONLINE/OFFLINE) + auto health 60s cache + persisted systemPromptOverride (ThinkingAgent + quick-send) + affinity_applied in native stats JSON + Stats budget/max-ctx lines

entries.problem: schema v3 onUpgrade was a dev reset - every update dropped the whole memory DB (experiences/facts/messages)
entries.cause: onUpgrade called DROP TABLE + onCreate as a dev shortcut
entries.solution: SCHEMA_VERSION 4 + real migration: v3->v4 keeps all existing tables and only adds source KB tables (source_collections, sources, source_files, source_chunks + external FTS5 source_chunks_fts with triggers); SourceSchema holds pure DDL strings shared with the JVM sqlite-jdbc twin; migration-retention test proves old rows survive

entries.problem: source registry/updater logic untestable on JVM because MemoryDatabase extends Android SQLiteOpenHelper
entries.cause: no storage contract; only the Android implementation existed
entries.solution: SourceStore interface implemented by MemoryDatabase (device) and JdbcSourceStore (test-only org.xerial:sqlite-jdbc, bundles FTS5) running the exact SourceSchema DDL; FakeSourceStore for unit tests; tests for migration retention, chunker bounds, candidate staleness order, 304 conditional fetch, changed-blob-only, read-time eviction, BM25 + LIKE search

entries.problem: RAW_TEXT sources errored on the periodic refresh (marked ERROR)
entries.cause: updateSourceInternal dispatched RAW_TEXT to the HTTP path, which requires a contentUrl
entries.solution: RAW_TEXT skipped in the updater - it is indexed once on add via db.replaceSourceChunks

entries.problem: chunk overlap disappeared after the word-boundary refactor
entries.cause: loop advanced start = end (no overlap), losing boundary context between chunks
entries.solution: advance start = end - overlapChars with a progress guard; SourceChunkerTest asserts consecutive chunks share words

entries.problem: future memory/Source-KB phases lacked a reference for scoped verbatim memory + pluggable retrieval
entries.cause: user pointed at MemPalace/mempalace (MIT) as a source of ideas for later phases
entries.solution: recorded docs/source-research/mempalace-reference.md: scoped hierarchy (wings/rooms/drawers) maps to collections/sources/files-chunks; pluggable backend seam matches SourceStore/MemoryProvider; hybrid keyword fallback validates FTS5+LIKE; embedder sizes (~80 MB minilm) give ADR-007 a real budget figure; LongMemEval R@5 as a future benchmark; keep read_time eviction for verbatim-growth control

entries.problem: local model support was hardcoded to one fixed path (models/model.gguf) in nine EngineScreen call sites; multiple GGUFs were impossible and LocalModelProvider always exposed descriptor id local-llama
entries.cause: MainActivity registered one LocalModelProvider; UI built modelFile from a fixed path; provider descriptor was a constant, so per-file providers would collide
entries.solution: LocalModelLibrary (pure JVM) scans models/*.gguf with stable ids (model.gguf -> local-llama, others -> local-<stem>); descriptor-override param on LocalModelProvider so each file gets its own provider sharing one NativeEngine; syncInto drops deleted files and keeps a local-llama placeholder when empty; LocalModelImporter (SAF) with progress + StatFs +64 MB margin + GGUF magic guard + temp rename; RemoteProviderBootstrap skips all local-* ids; picker '＋ Pick GGUF from storage…' row + size/quant subtitles; model card Delete; loadedPath guard reloads on model switch

entries.problem: 'Inconsistent JVM-target compatibility (1.8 vs 17)' fails compileDebugKotlin
entries.cause: AGP defaults Java target 1.8 while Kotlin jvmTarget defaulted to 17
entries.solution: compileOptions VERSION_17 + kotlinOptions { jvmTarget = "17" } inside android {}

entries.problem: no observability: AgentEvent lacked timestamps/durations, tool timings and tok/s were untracked, Stats only dumped memoryStats() to the status line
entries.cause: no metrics contract; trace events were plain data; no jank/leak tooling
entries.solution: RuntimeMetrics (load, first-token, tok/s, per-tool, errors/retries, restarts, jank) + DiagnosticsProvider/RuntimeDiagnostics + DiagnosticsDialog; AgentEvent atMs/durationMs with timestamped trace lines (TraceLine strips the prefix); FrameJankMonitor (Choreographer, no dep); LeakCanary debugImplementation only; .maestro/acceptance flows on the physical device (arm64-only APK cannot run on x86_64 CI emulators); docs/source-research/perf-observability-reference.md + license review rows

entries.problem: Engine Settings bottom sheet did not scroll on the phone (1080x2400): HARDWARE TUNING, Start service, Download GGUF, Stats and TOOL INVENTORY sat below the fold and were unreachable, so the buttons looked 'missing' and Download/Stats could not be exercised
entries.cause: ModalBottomSheet body Column had no scroll modifier; the sheet is full-height (skipPartiallyExpanded), so taller-than-screen content was clipped
entries.solution: added .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()) to the sheet Column

entries.problem: app SIGSEGV'd (native, fault addr 0x0) in ggml_compute_forward_rope (libggml-cpu-android_armv8.2_2.so) ~2 s after 'agent stopped' while running Qwen2.5-0.5B locally, killing the whole process (engine service runs in the same process)
entries.cause: stopRun() called runJob.cancel() but immediately released running/runJob; local generation is a blocking llama.cpp decode inside callbackFlow, so coroutine cancellation only closes the flow (which fires nativeCancel) and the native loop unwinds on the next sampled token (~0.5-1 s); starting a new run in that window overlapped two generations on one llama_context, corrupting the graph
entries.solution: stopRun() now calls engine.cancel() first (stops the native loop promptly) and keeps running=true until the job's finally unwinds, so a new run can never overlap a still-decoding engine; both quick-send and agent paths reset running in finally

entries.problem: startup status line was a stale constant ('Engine library loaded. Put a GGUF in: …') shown even when models/model.gguf existed
entries.cause: status was initialized once with a fixed string, never reflecting the actual library scan
entries.solution: initialize from LocalModelLibrary.scan(): empty -> guidance to Download/import; non-empty -> 'Local library ready: <files>'

entries.problem: pm install -r of the CI build failed INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE (signatures do not match) even though the workflow restores DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64
entries.cause: the installed app predates the current persistent keystore value; the secret was rotated/replaced at some point, so the old and new debug keys differ
entries.solution: one-time pm uninstall + reinstall (app data loss), re-stage the GGUF via run-as; future builds signed with the same secret update in place — verify with the next install before trusting 'persistent'

entries.problem: pushing code fix + docs back-to-back cancelled the code CI build
entries.cause: build.yml concurrency group build-<ref> with cancel-in-progress: true cancels the previous run on every push
entries.solution: push code first, wait for its run to finish (or at least pass the build job) before pushing docs; only the latest HEAD build matters

entries.problem: CI unit-test compile failed: document tests appended outside SourceUpdaterTest class + marker mismatch (doc-1-12 vs 13-byte PDF)
entries.cause: hand-edited test file placed new tests after the class closing brace; unchanged-doc marker did not match the real byte size
entries.solution: move appended tests back inside the class; use the real marker (doc-1-13); rely on CI test compilation even when a local build is impossible

entries.problem: SourceSeedLoader.parse('') threw JSONException in blankInputIsEmpty
entries.cause: only load() guarded exceptions; org.json JSONObject(String) throws on blank input
entries.solution: parse() now catches and returns an empty list - malformed catalogs are honest state, never a crash

entries.problem: one CI build per main push made validation serial; every push cancels the previous run
entries.cause: concurrency group build-<ref> with cancel-in-progress; on.push only builds main
entries.solution: feature work on ci/* branches + gh workflow run build.yml --ref ci/<branch> = parallel builds (per-ref concurrency); merge the validated branch into main

entries.problem: local inference had no runtime abstraction (GGUF/llama-only paths)
entries.cause: single phase-1 engine; MNN stayed a parked reference
entries.solution: RuntimeKind on ModelDescriptor, InferenceBackend seam, MnnBackend dlopen probe over CI-bundled libMNN.so 3.6.1; MNN model inference gated on an on-device benchmark

entries.problem: 'Unresolved reference ... BaseAppModuleExtension.kotlinOptions' in build.gradle.kts
entries.cause: kotlinOptions used at top level instead of scoped inside the android {} extension
entries.solution: move the block inside android {}

entries.problem: vector index had no owner; embeddings need a validated model
entries.cause: roadmap listed vectors but no runtime or gate existed
entries.solution: vendored USearch v2.11.3 headers + vector-lib + USearchVectorIndex (bounded/persisted) + EmbeddingProvider seam; hybrid BM25+HNSW RRF dormant until the benchmark gate passes

entries.problem: 'no matching function for call to llama_memory_clear' at b10428
entries.cause: KV-cache API refactor — memory ops take a llama_memory_t handle, not the context
entries.solution: llama_memory_clear(llama_get_memory(g_ctx), false) with null guard

entries.problem: lifecycleScope unresolved in MainActivity (receiver mismatch)
entries.cause: lifecycleScope is a LifecycleOwner extension; plain Activity is not a LifecycleOwner
entries.solution: own CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Main), cancel in onDestroy, drop lifecycle-runtime-ktx

entries.problem: llama_load_model_from_file / llama_free_model deprecated at b10428
entries.cause: llama.cpp renamed the model API (llama_model_load_from_file / llama_model_free)
entries.solution: use the current names, verified against the pinned header

entries.problem: sampler chain params at b10428 carry only no_perf — penalties missing
entries.cause: llama_sampler_chain_params has just no_perf; penalties are a separate sampler object
entries.solution: add llama_sampler_init_penalties(n_vocab, last_n, repeat, 0, 0) to the chain before top_k/top_p/temp/dist
